- Probe-record shape: the L9 close criterion binds the **real**

- Gate hardening found in test: a whitespace-only `flips.<leg>.confirmed`
  counted as confirmed; the gate now requires a non-empty stripped ref.
- `WAVE_B_FLIP_LIST.md` count corrected on review: 6 widen targets ride
  already-permitted sources + 1 consolidation (`deldot_red_light`)
  rides the flagged `dot_511_de` — 7 context rows, not 7 widen targets.

  the DC ASC pair failed the licence match and landed on the gated
  `camreg_dc_ddot_ate` fallback (ticket prose predates that check; the
  gate binds the registry).
- `SKILL-VALIDATOR-DRIFT` stays recorded as an existing finding
  (OPEN FINDINGS); not repaired without authority.
- Driver gate-propagation fix (self-review pass 2): `wave-b.sh` first
  mirrored `wave-a.sh`'s `if ! _gate …; then rc=$?` — inside the
  `then` branch `$?` is the exit of the *negated* pipeline (0), so a
  gate refusal (42) would have propagated `exit 0`. Rewritten as
  `rc=0; _gate … || rc=$?; [ rc -ne 0 ] → exit rc`. **The same defect
  exists in the landed `ops/gcp/wave-a.sh` (lines ~152–155)** — a
  Wave-A no-go would exit 0; recorded here for the fleet-hygiene row
  (P35.1b family), not silently rewritten (landed precedent).
- `sig-ops coverage-delta` invocation in L10 made honest: it runs with
  the recorded `SIG_COVERAGE_DELTA_ARGS` (baseline/plan refs from the
  run record), never a fabricated baseline.
- Orient-probe budget (ledger_contract V11, ≤ 48 KiB): the RETURN PASS
  table row was compacted to the mandatory excluded-hours tokens +
  terse cells, and the ticket Gate-status head trimmed — the probe
  reads 49,148 B after regen (in the closeout state, re-measured when
  the row lands). `check-build-memory.sh` and `ledger_contract.py`
